title: Combined-signal predictive Patient Trader: nine-input model of the next adverse mid move, fourth new universe (D)
units: implementation shortfall in cents per share (negative differences are savings); AUC of the probability that the first mid change within 60 s is adverse

rule_names.S2i: passive limit with one-tick improvement, market at the deadline
rule_names.C3: S2i when the arrival spread is at most 4 cents, else E*
rule_names.candidates: R1_h early fill when p >= h, R2_l hold when p <= l, R3_h_l both; p from the nine-input model

H1.sentence: 신호를 합친 예측은 처음 보는 종목에서도 다음 가격 움직임을 맞혔다

H2.sentence: 신호를 합친 예측은 검증 구간에서 E*를 이기지 못했다. 그래서 개선 가설은 봉인 데이터로 시험하지 않았다

predictions_check.item: 봉인에서 AUC(합친 모델)이 AUC(연구 18 모델)보다 큼

validation.note: existing universe 2019-2020; the single validation run chose A*
